payload.credit_html: Dinevenator, a new genus of troodontid dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous of New Mexico"
payload.description_html: Dorsal reconstruction of the skull of multiple troodontin troodontids: (A) Dinevenator robustus (Sullivan, 2006; [SMP VP-1955]) highlighting the frontal shape relative to that of (B) Xenovenator espinosai (CPC 2976), (C) Albertavenator curriei (TMP 1993.105.0001), and (D) Stenonychosaurus ("Troodon") inequalis (TMP 1993.036.0086 and TMP 1986.049.0010). Note: frontals highlighted in (A) blue, (B) red, (C) grey, and (D) green). Figure (A, C, D) modified from Evans et al.: (figure 4). Bar scale equals 1 cm.
